description: Return JPEG URLs for a verse card that composites verbatim scripture onto a pre-existing static image from the Sovereign Logos artwork library. This tool does not generate images. It draws stored verse text, the Sovereign Logos wordmark, and a QR code over a library background. Backgrounds are chosen from curated topics (mammon, false prophets, the Seed is Christ, idols, judgment), then verse tags and themes. The response lists 1 to 6 ranked options, each with a JPEG URL. plainOptions lists two cards with no artwork: navy and royal purple. The background argument accepts "plain" or "plain-royal" for one of those cards. With no translation argument, the server uses LXX2012, then the KJV where LXX2012 has no text (the New Testament).

background.description: Force a background id (from list_backgrounds) as option 1. "plain" or "plain-royal" give a plain brand card (see plainOptions).

count.description: How many background options to return.

exclude.description: Background ids to skip, e.g. ones already posted.

format.description: feed 1080x1350 (default, best for X and Instagram), square 1080x1080, story 1080x1920.

mood.description: Bias toward a mood: holy, contemplative, sovereign, grieving, wrathful, fierce, triumphant, pastoral.

psalmNumbering.description: How to read Psalm numbers in the reference. "mt" (default) = Masoretic/KJV numbering, converted for Septuagint translations. "native" = the translation's own numbering.

reference.description: Book chapter:verse[-verse], up to 8 verses, e.g. "Matthew 6:24".

translation.description: Optional. Default: lxx2012, falling back to kjv.

name: create_verse_image
title: Create verse image
